mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ticket_status_log (ticket_id, from_status, to_status, operator_id, reason) VALUES (#{ticketId}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{operatorId}, #{reason})
mapper.select: SELECT l.id, l.from_status, l.to_status, l.operator_id, l.reason, l.create_time, u.name AS operator_name FROM ticket_status_log l LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = l.operator_id WHERE l.ticket_id = #{ticketId} ORDER BY l.create_time ASC, l.id ASC
